final_message:
`createUser` now accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. `npm test` passes: 3 of 3, including the two nickname tests.

- **`src/api/users.js`:** `createUser` stores the nickname only when one is passed. `getUser` returns `nickname: r.nickname ?? null`.
- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js` (new):** adds the `nickname` column to `users`. The in-memory db rejects unknown columns, so the feature needed it.

`migrations/` is marked as owned by the DBA team. I left the already-applied migrations 001 and 002 alone and added a new file instead. The DBA team may want to review `003_add_nickname.js` before it ships.
